description: Prompts/09-supply-chain-and-trust.md deliverable 3. Weekly, grouped by ecosystem, nothing proposed before a release is 3 days old, and no automerge, ever (.ai/docs/philosophy.md section 8): a human merges every PR this opens.
Guarded by .ai/tests/test_workflows.py TestRenovateNeverMergesAnything. Setup and install steps: wiki/GeneralContext/Architecture/github-automation-setup.md section 7.

customManagers.description: The claude CLI version the workflows install, pinned once in .ai/config.json (providers.anthropic.cli_version, package named by cli_package). Matches nothing until that pin exists.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions, non-major, one PR. The digest helper keeps each SHA pin and its # vN comment current.
npm (frontend/ and infra/), non-major, one PR.
Python (backend/pyproject.toml, PEP 621), non-major, one PR. Matched by category, not manager: Renovate extracts this file with its poetry manager, not pep621.
Docker base images (docker/*.Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml), non-major, one PR.
Majors are deliberately not grouped: one PR per package, because a grouped major is an unreviewable PR.

The claude CLI, its own PR. Before approving, re-check the bumped CLI still accepts --setting-sources user --strict-mcp-config (.ai/docs/handoff.md section 10.1, D2b): the worker's isolation from checkout config depends on those flags.
prBodyNotes: **Re-check D2b before approving** (`.ai/docs/handoff.md` §10.1): run `npx --yes @anthropic-ai/claude-code@{{{newVersion}}} --help` and confirm it still lists `--setting-sources` and `--strict-mcp-config`. The worker relies on both to ignore `.claude/` and `.mcp.json` in the checkout.
